verses.text: minal haqqi jaa-al haqqu lil haqqi fis sahbi
bihaqqi mubiini laa yuhaaniihi min sahbi
kitaabun bihi narjuu minal laahi rahmatan
wa nanjuu bihi dunyaa wa ukhraa minal karbi
rajawnaa minal mawlaa bihi khayra matlabin
wa fuznaa bihi fii kulli dafhin wa fii jalbi
laqad saara kanzan baaqiyan hizzatan lanaa
yaqiinaa bihil mawlaa azaa kulli zii dabbi
izaa maatalawnal aaya fuznaa bimakh tafaa
halaa ghayrinaa min sirrihi jaalibil hubbi
qaharnaa bihil ahdaa-a turran wa qaadanaa
ilal akramil wahhabi fil buhdi wal qurbi
tafaraqanal ahdaa-u wash shakku wal balaa
bihi wa unilnal khisba bahdan tifal jadbi
zafirnaa bihi mimman hadaanaa talaqqiyan
bijaahil lazii amdaahuhu qad ghadat da-bii
halayhi salaatul laahi jalla jalaaluhu
bi as-haabihi han aalihi afdalil hizbi
halayhi salaamul laahi maadaama mustafaa
wa maa layynal mawlaa bihi as-habis sahbi
